tiers.none: Nothing is claimed. The agent may work, but ORCA says nothing verified about what its policy covers.
tiers.A: Connects and fails closed: for each route, a passing installed receipt for the pinned agent, version and host shows the agent connects and that the uncovered routes listed are refused or asked about.
tiers.B: Approvals validated: for each route, a passing installed receipt for the pinned agent, version and host runs every case the route can run against the real agent.
tiers.C: Execution guard certified: for each route, a passing connected receipt for the pinned agent, version and host runs every case the route can run, and no lifecycle or bypass case is excluded on any of its routes.

paths.what: ORCA's answer to an ACP session/request_permission ask (resolvePermission, read fresh per ask by acp-session.ts)

excluded.F01: The ask arrives as an ACP request the SDK has already parsed; there are no raw bytes for ORCA to refuse.
excluded.F02: Decided in the session's own process; there is no separate context file to lose.
excluded.F03: Nothing is installed in the agent for this route.
excluded.P02: No raw input or context file on this route (see F01 and F02).
excluded.A04: An ACP ask carries no working directory; the session's directory is fixed when the session opens.

paths.verifies: ORCA's answer to an ask that reaches it, from the policy read at that ask
unverified: That the agent sends an ask for every call it makes
That the agent honours the answer it gets
That events, logs and stored records about the ask are redacted

paths.what: ORCA's Claude Code PreToolUse hook (#704), run as its process runs it (runClaudePreToolHook)

excluded.L08: The hook only hands an ask back to Claude. Whether that ask reaches ORCA's answerer for the same call is unverified until an installed receipt shows it; the answerer cases run on acp-ask.
excluded.F04: The hook never answers allow and offers no options, so there is no option for ORCA to pick on this route.

paths.verifies: The hook program's answer to a PreToolUse frame, with the context ORCA wrote
unverified: That Claude runs the hook on every call, remembered grants included
That a hook ask reaches ORCA as an ACP ask for the same call
That Claude blocks on deny, on a block, on a timeout and when the hook cannot start
That events, logs and stored records about the call are redacted

receipts.note: A receipt is a JSON file committed under tools/guard-qualification/receipts/. It names kind (installed or connected), agent, agentVersion, adapterVersion, host, route, build (the 40-hex ORCA commit it ran), checks.connects, checks.uncoveredRoutesRefused and per-case results, with no case listed twice. It must match the row's pin (agentVersion, adapterVersion, host, build). Tiers are cumulative. These checks are structural only: promotion above none is disabled until a receipt is bound to an independently trusted run. Synthetic receipts never count. A file path or a named residual risk is not proof.
